title: Six-Compartment Hinged Bait Box
description: One original low-poly low hard-shell empty bait box. A single closed tray mesh has a real thick bottom, four outer walls and an open interior, divided into six shallow rectangular compartments by three finitely connected solid partitions. A thick hard lid with a shallow recessed interior stays in one fixed raised pose. Two complete hinge assemblies each have three genuinely bored annular knuckles, two body brackets, a lid tongue and one fixed pin with finite static overlap in the hole walls. Two small front latch plates are fixed appearance only. One complete grounded assembly counts as one prop. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, origin centered on the box footprint at ground.
